digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow cancellation and job routing
propositions: Jobs with always() predicates remain eligible during workflow cancellation even when superseded by later patchsets, causing stale matrix and reusable jobs to consume runner-seconds (1,785s and 1,510s delay observed in run pair 31834162663 -> 31834896849).

Seven full-route job predicates must be updated to use !cancelled() status checks instead of always() to become ineligible upon run cancellation while preserving docs-only and classifier-failure routing contracts.
When classifier fails and run is not canceled, all seven full-route jobs must remain eligible and execute the full fallback route as a blocking result.

Successor job creation must not wait for natural completion of stale full-route matrix and reusable jobs after a same-change patchset replacement; prompt cancellation at 78-110 seconds post-replacement is required.
